<div id="pagination" class="project-pagination"></div>

<script>

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

  const projectsPerPage = 8;
  const projects = document.querySelectorAll("#projects-container .project-card");
  const pagination = document.getElementById("pagination");

  const totalPages = Math.ceil(projects.length / projectsPerPage);
  let currentPage = 1;

  function showPage(page) {

    currentPage = page;

    projects.forEach((project, index) => {

      const start = (page - 1) * projectsPerPage;
      const end = start + projectsPerPage;

      if (index >= start && index < end) {
        project.style.display = "";
      } else {
        project.style.display = "none";
      }

    });

    createPagination();

    window.scrollTo({
      top: document.querySelector("#projects-container").offsetTop - 80,
      behavior: "smooth"
    });
  }

  function createPagination() {

    pagination.innerHTML = "";

    if (totalPages <= 1) {
      return;
    }

    const previous = document.createElement("button");
    previous.innerHTML = "← Previous";
    previous.className = "pagination-btn";

    previous.disabled = currentPage === 1;

    previous.onclick = function () {
      if (currentPage > 1) {
        showPage(currentPage - 1);
      }
    };

    pagination.appendChild(previous);

    for (let i = 1; i <= totalPages; i++) {

      const button = document.createElement("button");

      button.innerHTML = i;
      button.className = "pagination-btn";

      if (i === currentPage) {
        button.classList.add("active");
      }

      button.onclick = function () {
        showPage(i);
      };

      pagination.appendChild(button);
    }

    const next = document.createElement("button");

    next.innerHTML = "Next →";
    next.className = "pagination-btn";

    next.disabled = currentPage === totalPages;

    next.onclick = function () {
      if (currentPage < totalPages) {
        showPage(currentPage + 1);
      }
    };

    pagination.appendChild(next);
  }

  showPage(1);

});

</script>
